QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Mr. Pickall, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p900015##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p900015#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

0.0: "There isn't a whole lot you're forced to do as a resident of #m10003000#, but hey, if you're up for it, I'd highly recommend chatting with the locals around here. Come to think of it, it would be a good idea to go say hi to #p900015# as well.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: What brings you here, huh? You come here 'cause you got a box you wanna open, huh? Wait... Haha! You the new resident of this city, huh? Good choice! Glad to meet you, my friend!
1.1: As you can see, there is no lock in the world this big guy cannot open! That is why everyone comes to me with all kinds of suspicious boxes, you see? But no need to worry! Whatever is inside the customer's box is a total secret! I never tell, huh?
1.2: Anyway, congrats on becoming a resident of this city! If you ever find a lock that just won't open, you come find me anytime! Of course, nothing in this world is free, you know? See ya later, huh!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
